name: Huacachina
blurb: Huacachina is a small village and desert oasis in southwestern Peru near Ica, built around a natural lagoon and surrounded by towering sand dunes. It attracts tens of thousands of annual visitors who primarily come to experience sandboarding and dune buggy rides.

positive: Unique and spectacular desert oasis scenery
Fun sandboarding and dune buggy experiences
Great spot for photography and day trips

quotes.text:
Huacachina, situated in southwestern Peru, is a village that encircles a small oasis and is enveloped by sand dunes. [📹 joseleon3011]

Original post
Daddy TFo went dune buggying and sand boarding in Huacachina, Peru. Some of the sand dunes are over 1,00 feet high. Quite the unique experience in a beautiful desert oasis.

Huacachina, Peru, a desert oasis, has a permanent population of around 100 people.👀♥️

While the town itself is small, it attracts tens of thousands of tourists annually. 

It is a popular destination for activities like sandboarding and dune buggy rides. #sand #dunes

And yes I slid down the sand hills on a board like a kid! So fun 😁✈️🗺️
